introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.description: Welcome to docline v1 English docs.
introduction.html:
Introduction

docline compiles MDX to static HTML at build time and ships a static search index.

This page demonstrates real MDX components rendered through the MDX compiler.

Static build

Generate pages during build, not at runtime.

Config-driven

Control versions, locales, and navigation in docs.json.

Install dependencies

Run npm install in the repository root.

Compile static docs

Start local preview

Why static generation

All markdown and MDX are compiled ahead of time into static HTML and search data.

Quickstart Endpoint (Tabs)

curl -X POST https://api.example.com/v1/tickets \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DOCS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"title":"Printer offline","priority":"high"}'

const response = await fetch('https://api.example.com/v1/tickets', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.DOCS_TOKEN}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ title: 'Printer offline', priority: 'high' }),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data.id);

import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://api.example.com/v1/tickets",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {DOCS_TOKEN}"},
    json={"title": "Printer offline", "priority": "high"},
    timeout=10,
)

print(response.json()["id"])

advanced-highlight-demo.title: Advanced Highlight Demo
advanced-highlight-demo.description: Stress-test page for syntax highlighting quality across complex grammars.
advanced-highlight-demo.html:
JavaScript (Regex + Template Literals)

JS
const routePattern = /^(?<method>GET|POST|PATCH)\s+(?<path>\/api\/[\w/-]+)$/i;

export function parseRoute(input) {
  const match = routePattern.exec(input?.trim() || '');
  if (!match?.groups) throw new Error(`Invalid route: ${input}`);

  const { method, path } = match.groups;
  return {
    method,
    path,
    cacheKey: `${method}:${path}`,
  };
}

Line Highlight + Filename Demo

src/lib/route-parser.ts
type ParsedRoute = {
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PATCH';
  path: string;
  cacheKey: string;
};
 
export function toCacheKey(input: ParsedRoute): string {
  const normalizedPath = input.path.replace(/\/+$/, '');
  return `${input.method}:${normalizedPath}`;
}

SQL (CTE + JSON)

SQL
WITH active_users AS (
  SELECT id, email, metadata
  FROM users
  WHERE active = true
),
user_stats AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    email,
    metadata->>'plan' AS plan,
    jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(metadata->'roles', '[]'::jsonb)) AS role_count
  FROM active_users
)
SELECT *
FROM user_stats
WHERE role_count > 0
ORDER BY email ASC;

Dockerfile (Multi-stage)

DOCKERFILE
FROM node:22-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci

FROM node:22-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM nginx:alpine AS runtime
COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
EXPOSE 80
CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]

GraphQL + Fragments

GRAPHQL
fragment PageCore on Page {
  slug
  title
  description
}

query SearchPages($query: String!, $limit: Int = 10) {
  searchPages(query: $query, limit: $limit) {
    ...PageCore
    updatedAt
    score
  }
}

Rust + Lifetimes

RUST
fn pick_longer<'a>(left: &'a str, right: &'a str) -> &'a str {
    if left.len() >= right.len() { left } else { right }
}

fn main() {
    let a = String::from("docline");
    let b = "docs";
    println!("{}", pick_longer(&a, b));
}

type ApiResult<T> = { ok: true; data: T } | { ok: false; error: string };

async function fetchJson<T>(url: string): Promise<ApiResult<T>> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url);
    if (!res.ok) return { ok: false, error: `HTTP ${res.status}` };
    return { ok: true, data: (await res.json()) as T };
  } catch (error) {
    return { ok: false, error: String(error) };
  }

v1:en.text: Introduction Welcome to docline v1 English docs. Introduction docline compiles MDX to static HTML at build time and ships a static search index.
